verdict.rationale: Missions let you define features, milestones, and success criteria with Droid before any code is written [factory-docs-22]. Droid also shows what it will modify before applying anything [factory-docs-18], and the CLI and exec modes include approvals and tiered autonomy that require manual confirmation [factory-docs-15, factory-docs-7]. These pieces together approximate a scope-and-contract gate, but none is documented as a formal sign-off that blocks repository changes. missing for 10: an explicit approval step for the plan/spec that must pass before repo writes, a separate approver role so a lead can sign off on another person's task, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
